Appreciate the quick reply, Diane. A few technical points and requests to make the deep-dive productive. I'll keep this actionable.

1) SDK & auth
- We support: API key (KMS-backed), short-lived tokens (recommended for private deployments), and OAuth for SSO flows.
- For Cartwheel's needs (audit logs + RBAC) we recommend short-lived tokens minted by your auth service + Redwood token exchange; avoids long-lived secrets.
- Could you share your token rotation cadence (hours) and whether you require per-tenant tokens?

2) Dimension & projection strategy
- Option A: keep 768 and serve 1:1 on Redwood. Fastest cutover, minimal embedding re-ingestion.
- Option B: move to 1536 (new encoder) — recommended for improved recall but requires full re-ingestion or projection.
- Projection: we can provide an online projection shim that takes VecCloud 768 -> 1536 via a small learned MLP. That reduces downtime and allows A/B testing.

3) Batching / latency guidance
- For 12M vectors + QPS 150–200, start with server-side batch sizes of 32–64 for ingestion; for queries, recommend async batching window 5–10ms with continuous batching.
- If you need p95 < 120ms, we suggest conservative batch windows and local KV cache for hot prefixes.

4) Normalization & similarity
- We support L2-normalized vectors and cosine similarity in the index layer. If you currently use unnormalized vectors, we recommend L2 normalization at ingest to keep dot-product vs cosine semantics stable.

5) Migration playbook (sketch)
- Phase 0: small subset export (10k) — verify similarity parity.
- Phase 1: parallel index (read-to) — replicate traffic via shadowing to Redwood for a week.
- Phase 2: cutover during low-traffic window with revert plan.
- Phase 3: decommission VecCloud once signals and user metrics stabilize.

Attachments I've dropped here for the call: auth_flow.png (recommended token exchange), proj_snippet.py (example projection code), migration_playbook.md (detailed checklist).

Two quick asks before the session:
- Can you share a 10k CSV (id,text,vec) and one representative query log segment?
- Confirm whether your data retention window requires us to keep original vector payloads for audit.

Proposed times for the deep-dive: Fri 23 Jul 10:00–11:00 PT (Jonas already suggested) or Mon 26 Jul 09:00–10:00 PT.

I'll send a calendar invite for the Friday slot; please update if needed.
